subject.title: Feature request: Shareable cron job templates

question: Should ClawHub support shareable cron-job templates as a first-class catalog/install surface, and if so which artifact and trust model should own them?
rationale: The source tree shows no implemented cron-template surface, and the requested one-click scheduled install path crosses product scope and security boundaries that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Define a first-class cron-template model
options.body: Keep the issue open as an RFC and specify schema, preview, install consent, moderation, and OpenClaw runtime behavior before implementation.

options.title: Constrain the idea to existing skills/plugins
options.body: Tell contributors to publish automation skills or plugins today, without adding cron-specific one-click install semantics until a runtime contract exists.

options.title: Decline standalone scheduled templates
options.body: Close or defer the idea if maintainers decide recurring-job install authority is too broad for ClawHub's current scope.

recommendation.title: Define a first-class cron-template model
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open as an RFC and specify schema, preview, install consent, moderation, and OpenClaw runtime behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest current-history owner for the package/catalog schema and install-surface decisions this feature would affect.
